info.title: API.SH: GIPHY
info.description: The GIPHY API from API.SH: public GIPHY data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
GIPHY GIFs, stickers, clips or animated text for a search term (by default the first 25 results GIPHY shows): id, title, alt text, rating, tags, page, embed and short links, GIF, MP4 and WebP links with size and frames, every rendition (fixed height and width, downsized, stills, previews), source, flags, dates and the creator's channel (name, avatar, description, verified, social links). With `limit`, `page`/`offset`, `rating`, `lang` or `sort` (and always for clips and text) the response also has `total_count`, `offset`, `limit`, `page` and `has_more` for paging through up to 5,000 results.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/giphy-search

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: gifs (default), stickers, clips (GIFs with sound) or text (animated text).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1 = first), counted in pages of `limit`. Pass `page` + 1 while `has_more` is true.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Start at this result (0-based) instead of `page`.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Highest content rating to include: g, pg, pg-13 or r.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: 2-letter language of the search term (e.g. en, es, pt, fr), for better matches in that language.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/giphy-trending

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1 = first), counted in pages of `limit`.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Start at this result (0-based) instead of `page`.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Highest content rating to include: g, pg, pg-13 or r.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
